guidance.bestFor: A single line message from one bare call with no options, the minimum a toast needs
A title over a second line passed as description, here an event name with its date and time
A grid of 6 buttons that each send their toast to a different top or bottom corner or center
agentNotes: Each call passes its own `position`; pick one and set it on `Toaster` so every toast shares that spot

guidance.bestFor: Default, success, error, warning, info and loading side by side, with the 4 status icons each tinted its own color
agentNotes: `toast.loading` never closes on its own; pass the id it returns to `toast.success` or `toast.error` to settle it

guidance.bestFor: Timers of 2, 5 and 10 seconds beside a persistent notice that stays until it is closed
agentNotes: `duration` is in milliseconds and `Infinity` turns the timer off, so the Persistent button adds `closeButton` as the way out

guidance.bestFor: An archive notice with an Undo button inside the toast that confirms with a second success toast
agentNotes: Undo only fires `toast.success`; restore the archived conversation inside the `action` `onClick`

whenNotToUse.when: A choice between confirming and cancelling inside the toast

guidance.bestFor: A deploy whose spinner becomes a success or error line when its promise settles, quoting the resolved name
agentNotes: The `Promise` that resolves after `setTimeout` stands in for your deploy call; hand the real one to `toast.promise`

whenNotToUse.when: Progress steps with their own messages that no single promise tracks

name: c-sonner-8
title: Toast with custom close and cancel buttons
label: Action & Cancel
description: Toast with custom close and cancel buttons

guidance.bestFor: A delete prompt inside the toast with a Delete action and a Cancel button that just closes it
agentNotes: Delete only fires `toast.success` and the `cancel` `onClick` is empty; run the deletion in the `action` handler

whenNotToUse.when: A permanent deletion the user must answer before doing anything else

guidance.bestFor: A teammate chat message with avatar, sender, time ago and Reply and Dismiss buttons on the popover surface
agentNotes: Reply and Dismiss both call `toast.dismiss` with no id, which closes every open toast; open your reply view from Reply

guidance.bestFor: A file card whose progress bar fills in place under one toast id, closing 3 seconds after it reaches 100
agentNotes: `setInterval` adds a random step of 5 to 19 every 500ms to fake progress; call `toast.custom` with the same `id` from your upload events
`intervalRef` holds only the latest timer, so a second click before 100 orphans the first; keep 1 handle per upload

whenNotToUse.when: Progress kept in the page as a list, one row per item being sent

guidance.bestFor: A deploy result with a green status dot, environment, duration and commit rows, and View Logs and Open Site
agentNotes: View Logs and Open Site only call `toast.dismiss`, closing all toasts; point them at your log and site URLs

whenNotToUse.when: A deploy summary that must stay in the page after it is read

guidance.bestFor: A release notice marked by a thick blue left edge and an info icon, offering Later or Update Now
agentNotes: Update Now only calls `toast.dismiss` like Later does; start your update from its `onClick`

guidance.bestFor: A paid invoice confirmation on the inverted surface with a green check badge and one View Receipt button
agentNotes: `bg-invert` and `text-invert-foreground` need invert theme variables that this install does not add, or the card has no fill

guidance.bestFor: A failed build listing 2 file and line errors in monospace above View Logs and a red Retry Build
agentNotes: The card fill `bg-invert` stays empty until your theme defines the invert color variables, which this example does not ship
Retry Build and View Logs only call `toast.dismiss`; start the rebuild from Retry Build

guidance.bestFor: A collaboration invite from a named teammate with an avatar, a Decline and a blue Accept on the inverted surface
agentNotes: Accept and Decline both just call `toast.dismiss`; send the answer to the invite from each `onClick`
Without invert theme variables `bg-invert` generates no class, so define them before installing this card

guidance.bestFor: A session timeout warning held for 10 seconds, whose amber Extend Session button swaps in a success toast
agentNotes: Extend Session only runs `toast.dismiss` then `toast.success`; refresh the session before the success message
`bg-invert` relies on invert color variables a plain shadcn theme lacks; add them or the warning card is see through

guidance.bestFor: A pull request ready to merge, with an overlapping stack of 3 reviewer avatars and View and green Merge
agentNotes: `reviewers` holds 3 sample people with remote photos; pass the real approvers of the pull request
Merge only calls `toast.dismiss` and `toast.success`; call your merge from its `onClick` first
`bg-invert` and the avatar ring `border-invert` both need invert theme variables that this example leaves out

guidance.bestFor: An uploaded file notice whose close button is moved from the default top left corner to the top right
A row of 3 plain notices that each pass their own leading glyph: send, download and bookmark
A connected workspace card with a gradient link tile, Active status, a channel sync line and Configure and Open Dashboard
agentNotes: Configure and Open Dashboard only call `toast.dismiss`; route them to your integration settings and dashboard

guidance.bestFor: A spinner line rewritten through a stored toast id from preparing to 30 and 70 percent, then a success card
agentNotes: The 3 `setTimeout` steps fake the upload; call `toast.custom` with `toastId` from your real progress callbacks
Loading steps pass `Infinity` as `duration`, so an upload that fails must update or dismiss `toastId` or the spinner never closes

whenNotToUse.when: A determinate bar that fills as bytes arrive
